You'll need to build your initial steam power elsewhere, expand as needed.
You'll need to upgrade to steel furnaces and red belts as needed (this will require the second ore input for each upgraded furnace array)
Initial base ore inputs on right. Uranium input on left. Bottom of base is rocket parts, inputs on bottom. 
Upgrade assemblers to 2 and 3 when available, add prod or speed modules as desired. 
module array on left, robot mall on right, add to these, turn on and off to conserve resources, as needed.
replace labs with biolabs, beacons, and redesign for robot science delivery when needed.
title: My initial nauvis base
